COMPANY PROFILE: 
 
BHEL incorporated in 1964 as a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) has been at the forefront of powering India’s 
growth, serving as a trusted partner in nation-building and a leader in the capital goods sector. BHEL is backed 
by a robust manufacturing network comprising 15 manufacturing units, 08 service centres, 15 Regional 
Marketing Centres, 04 Regional Offices and 02 Repair Units. Combining world -class engineering, 
manufacturing, project execution expertise, and after-sales support, BHEL serves a broad spectrum of sectors 
including power, transportation, defence, aerospace, oil & gas, and process industries with a significant 
contribution to India's power generation capacity across thermal, hydro, gas, nuclear, and solar segments. 
The Company has its footprint in all the 6 inhabited continents with presence in 95 countries. BHEL continues 
to be a key enabler of the country's energy security, infrastructure development, and self-reliance objectives. 
Presently, the total order book stands at all time high of more than Rs. 2.6 Lakh Crores, reaffirming customer 
confidence and strong revenue visibility. 
 
BHEL offers a challenging and rewarding career to young and skilled artisans to contribute towards Nation 
building in the fields of Power, Ind ustry, Transmission, Renewable Energy, Transportation, Energy Storage, 
Defence & Aerospace and Oil & Gas. 
The following Manufacturing Units of BHEL are looking for ARTISANS in the various trades as per the details 
below:  
 
(A) Boiler Auxiliaries Plant (BAP)- RANIPET, TAMILNADU  
(B) Heavy Plates and Vessels Plant (HPVP) – VISHAKHAPATNAM, ANDHRA PRADESH 
(C) Electronics Division (EDN) - BENGALURU, KARNATAKA 
(D) Solar Business Division (SBD) - BENGALURU, KARNATAKA 
(E) Heavy Electrical Equipment Plant (HEEP) - HARIDWAR, UTTRAKHAND 
(F) Heavy Power Equipment Plant (HPEP) - HYDERABAD, TELANGANA 
(G) Heavy Electrical Plant (HEP) - BHOPAL, MADHYA PRADESH 
(H) Transformer Plant (TP) – JHANSI, UTTAR PRADESH 
(I) High Pressure Boiler Plant (HPBP) – TIRUCHIRAPPALLI

 BHARAT HEAVY ELECTRICALS LIMITED 
ARTISAN RECRUITMENT - 2027 
 
Advt. 01/2026 
 
 
Note:  
1. As per Company policy, the vacancies of “Artisan Grade – IV” are partially earmarked for being filled 
through dependents of deceased employees of BHEL on Compassionate grounds. All relevant details 
as to how to / who can apply under this category are given in “Compassionate Consideration’ Link on 
our website http://careers.bhel.in. In case these vacancies are not filled up due to non -availability of 
qualified candidates, they may be filled through open selection. 
 
2. Candidates may note that the Computer Based Exam (CBE) for the above vacancies shal l be 
conducted on the same day. Accordingly, candidates are advised to carefully select the Manufacturing 
Unit and trade for which they wish to apply. A candidate shall be permitted to apply for vacancies in 
ONE Manufacturing Unit and ONE Trade only.  
 
3. The candidates selected as “Artisan Grade – IV” under this recruitment shall be required to serve at 
their allocated Manufacturing Unit for at least 20 years from the date of joining. During this period, 
no request for transfer or change in place of posting shall be entertained for the first Twenty years of 
service.  
 
4. If in the interim period, for any unavoidable personal reasons if a candidate selected as “Artisan Grade 
– IV” requests a transfer back to a Unit of his/her preference, the transfer can only b e considered 
subject to suitable position being available and shall be on reversion to the original post on which 
he/she was absorbed in the Company.   
 
5. Candidates who have already been selected/engaged as Temporary Employees or for any other post 
and presently not regularized or on  probation in BHEL  shall not be eligible to apply for the present 
recruitment and their candidature shall not considered. 
 
RESERVATIONS: 
The above vacancies are reserved as follows: - 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
For PWD candidates: The positions of Artisan Grade - IV in BHEL are identified: For OH: Locomotor Disability 
(BL or OL)* - BL only for Electrician or Fitter , leprosy cured, Dwarfism & Acid Attack Victim, For VH: Low 
Vision For HH: Deaf & Hard of Hearing, Speech and Language Disability, For MD: Multiple Disabilities.  
Scribe facility shall be available for persons with benchmark disabilities in the category of locomotor disability 
and any other identified benchmark disability, provided that candidate produces original medical certificate  
and physical limitation certificate (format on website https://careers.bhel.in), issued by competent medical 
authority regarding such disability at the time of entry to examination centre (as per government guidelines). 
The post of Artisans in BHEL is not identified suitable for “Blindness”. 
QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENT: (As on 1st October, 2026) 
 
Class Xth PLUS National Trade Certificate (NTC / ITl) PLUS  
National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade  
WITH NOT LESS THAN 
60% marks for Gen & OBC candidates and 55% marks for SC & ST candidates in both NTC/ITI and NAC. 
Desirable: Knowledge of Regional Language for Tamil Nadu, Telangana/Andhra Pradesh & Karnataka based Units 
and Hindi for other Units.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS IN RESPECT OF ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION(S) 
 
1. Essential educational qualification(s) required as indicated in the Table for respective post are 
mandatory. Candidate should be possessing requisite certificate(s)/ Marksheets for ITI/NAC issued up 
to 1 st October, 2026. Knowledge/ Skills/ Proficiency in the respective discipline shall be assessed 
through Computer Based Examination and Skill Test.  
2. Only full time Regular courses will be considered.  
3. National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) wherever applicable, should be issued by concerned 
authority. 
4. Ex-servicemen claiming equivalence in qualification shall be required to produce a copy of equivalence 
certificate. The minimum marks in qualification shall not be required for Ex-servicemen claiming Trade 
Equivalency from an Army/ Air Force/Naval Institute issued certificate. 
5. SC/ ST /PwBD candidates applying against post not reserved for such categories shall be considered 
under general standard of merit and no relaxation in minimum qualifying percentage  of marks in 
education qualification shall be available to them.  
 
UPPER AGE LIMIT & RELAXATIONS: (As on 1st October, 2026) 
 
The upper age limit for General and EWS category candidates shall be 27 years as on 01.10.2026. 
Age Relaxation  on account of Experience : Candidates shall be eligible for age relaxation of up to a 
maximum limit 07 years on the basis of work experience, subject to a minimum of 06 months of relevant work 
experience and submission of experience in the prescribed format (available on BHEL Careers Website).  
Upper age limit is further relaxable for candidates belonging to the following categories as under: -  
• SC/ST: - by 5 years  
• OBC (NCL): – by 3 years   
• Persons with Disabilities Candidates: - by 10 years for General - by 13 years for OBC (NCL) - 
by 15 years for SC/ST.  
• Relaxation in age for Ex-Servicemen will be as per extant Govt. rules.  
• Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for the candidates who had ordinarily been domiciled in 
the state of Jammu & Kashmir during the period from 1/1/1980 to 31/12/1989. 
Note: Notwithstanding the age relaxations admissible under provisions of this advertisement, the maximum 
age of a candidate, including all permissible age relaxations, shall not exceed 56 years as on 01.10.2026. 
EMOLUMENTS AND BENEFITS: 
 
Selected candidates will work as “Temporary Artisans” for a period of one year during which they will be paid 
consolidated wages of Rs 24,000 per Month. On successful completion of this temporary period, they will be 
regularized in the regular establishment as ARTISAN GRADE-IV and placed at the minimum of the scale of 
pay of Rs 29500 – Rs 65,000 with applicable allowance s in vogue at the time of regulari zation. The 
regularization in the regular establishment will be as per the extant Company rules. 
 
SELECTION PROCESS: 
 
Candidates interested in joining BHEL as ARTISAN GRADE-IV shall have to undergo a Two Stage Selection 
Process and necessarily be required to clear both stages in order to be considered for Merit List: 
Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE) 
All candidates will have to appear for a Computer Based Examination (CBE) in their respective trades. Based 
on CBE Marks, candidates will be shortlisted for Skill Test in order of merit in ratio of 1:3 to the number of 
vacancies in their respective trades  as per category wise vacancies available in their respective unit of 
candidature submission. In case of single vacancy in a particular trade/category, a maximum of 5 candidates 
shall be shortlisted for the particular position. 
There shall be a minimum qua lifying mark in the Computer Based Examination (CBE) of 40% Marks for UR 
or EWS Category & 30% Marks for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/SC/ST Categories. Any candidate scoring below 
the minimum qualifying marks in Computer Based Examination (CBE) shall be disquali fied from further 
selection process. 
 
PwD candidates & Ex -Servicemen candidates will be accorded relaxation below the cut -off marks in 
respective categories (limited to minimum qualifying of 30% Marks for UR/EWS and minimum qualifying of 
22.5% Marks for OBC/SC & ST Categories) for being shortlisted for Skill Test in the similar prescribed ratio of 
1:3 or a maximum of 5 candidates in case of single vacancy. 
For shortlisting as per 1:3 ratio, initially, all UR candidates along with reserved category (i.e. EWS, OBC, SC, 
ST) candidates of that trade in the respective unit, who do not avail any relaxation, will be grouped together 
and then arranged in descending order of merit of their CBE  marks (marks out of 100) and candidates shall 
be called for Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 in UR category. After this, candidates belonging to EWS/OBC/SC/ST 
categories as per available vacancies , who are not shortlisted under UR category, shall be regroup ed with 
their respective categories for further consideration and shortlisted for Skill Test in prescribed ratio of 1:3 in 
their respective categories.  
Stage II: Skill Test & Document Verification 
All such shortlisted candidates shall be required to undergo Document Verification to confirm their eligibility 
as per the notification and thereafter, would be required to undergo a Skill Test, which shall be qualifying in 
nature.  
Skill Test is the second stage of the selection process. All shortlisted candidates must necessarily attend and 
complete this stage of selection process, in order to be considered for being placed on the merit list.  
After being found “Eligible” as per Document Verification & “Qualified” in the Skill Test, the final merit order 
shall be prepared on the basis of CBE Score.    
PREFERENCE FOR BEST/ RUNNERUP APPRENTICE: 
Preference is given for BEST Apprentice/ RUNNER UP Apprentice at All India SKILL Competitions conducted 
by The Directorate General of Employment and Training. These candidates who were/are selected as BEST 
APPRENTICE or RUNNER UP APPRENTICE in the All India SKILL Test, will be required to apply online and 
submit their application as per the prescribed procedure.  Such candidates shall be necessarily required to 
Upload their “Certificate of Merit” of Best Apprentice/ Runner -Up Apprentice in the All India Apprentices 
Competition issued by Directorate General of Employment and Training. 
They shall be required to appear for the Computer Based test and shall be called for skill test subject to 
fulfilling other Terms and Conditions and Eligibility criteria as per the notification. In the event of their selection, 
Best Apprentice will be induc ted as Artisan Grade - IV with 2 increments and Runner Up Apprentice will be 
inducted as Artisan Grade - IV at the minimum of the scale in the pay scale of Rs 29500 – Rs 65,000. 
MEDICAL STANDARDS:  
 
Applicants should possess sound health. Before Joining, selected candidates will have to undergo medical 
examination by the Company’s Authorized Officer and the appointment will be subject to meeting the health 
standards prescribed by the Company. No relaxation in health standards is allowed. The company’s Medical 
Examination rules in brief can be accessed @ BHEL's Medical Examination Rules  – hosted on the BHEL 
careers website. 
 
The Persons with Disability candidates are required to furnish self -attested copy of duly stamped Medical 
Certificate in relation to their benchmark disability from Government Hospital or Medical Board attached to 
Special Employment Exchange for the handicapped. 
 
GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS: 
 
 
1. The submission of applications will be ONLINE only through our website https://careers.bhel.in. 
Applicant must read the instructions for submission carefully and ensure that the application is 
submitted successfully and transaction with reference to payment of fee for application form and / or 
processing fee as applicable is successfully transacted.  
 
 
2. Candidates who are registered with Local Employment Exchange(s) and meet the prescribed eligibility 
criteria are advised to apply Online on BHEL Careers portal. No other mode of application in this regard 
will be entertained. 
 
3. A Non-Refundable Application Fee and Processing fee will be applicable as indicated below:  
Applicable Fees* for “Artisan Grade – IV” Recruitment 
Category Examination Fee Processing Fee Total 
UR/EWS/OBC Rs 600 Rs 400 +GST Rs 1072 
SC/ST/PWD/Ex-Servicemen NIL Rs 400 +GST Rs 472 
*The applicant may have to bear Bank Charges over & above the application fees, depending upon fees 
payment through Internet banking/Debit card/ Credit Card etc. 
 
4. Candidates must note that, for all the above vacancies, the Computer Based Exam shall be held on 
the same day and candidates must carefully apply  against vacancies of ONE Trade and ONE unit 
only. In case of multiple submission of ONLINE applications from same applicant, only the last 
submitted application shall be considered as final submission for candidature in BHEL. 
 
5. All applicant will be given option to choose amongst the Test Centers/ Venue for up to 5 choices. 
However, BHEL reserves the right to add or cancel any city/center depending upon the no. of 
candidates choosing a particular city/center. 
 
6. Applicants are also informed that the Computer Based Examination shall be trilingual, i.e with an 
option to attempt the Examination in Hindi or English or third language of their choice (Kannada, Telegu 
and Tamil). The same option shall be given at the time of Skill Test also, i.e to address the Selection 
Committee in their language of preference between Hindi or English or their vernacular language. 
 
7. The Candidate should ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria and other requirements and that the 
particulars furnished by them are correct in all respect. In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment 
process that the candidate does not meet the eligibility criteria and/or the candidate has furnished any 
incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), the candidature of such a candidate 
is liable to be rejected. If any of the above shortcoming(s) is/are detected, even after appointment, 
his/her services are liable for suitable actions including termination and prosecution. 
 
8. The details entered by the candidate at the time of online registration shall be final. While applying the 
candidates should enter his name as it appears in the SSC/Matriculation Certificate. Further, request 
for change of Mailing Address/email ID/ Category/Posts as declared in the online application shall not 
be entertained. 
 
9. The category [GEN/EWS/SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/ PwBD /Ex-Servicemen/Compassionate Consideration] 
of the candidate claimed in the online application form for the post shall be treated as final. Once filled 
the online application form will neither be changed nor benefit of any other category will be admissible 
later on. 
 
10. Candidates belonging to OBC category but not covered under 'Non-Creamy Layer' are not entitled to 
OBC reservation. As such, they should indicate their category as 'GENERAL'.  
 
11. Only such PwBD Category candidates would be eligible to get the applicable benefit of reservation 
who suffer from  not less than 40% of relevant disability. For claiming the benefit of reservation/ 
concessions applicable for PwBDs, the candidates will have to submit a disability certificate as per 
formats prescribed by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment vide notification no. G.S.R. 591 
(E) dated 15.06.2017 in support of their claim. In case, the candidate fails to produce the certificate in 
the prescribed format issued by Competent Authority, his/ her candidature shall not be considered. 
 
12. Candidates belonging to OBC (Non ‐Creamy Layer)  category should produce their latest caste 
certificate issued on or after 01.01.2026 in the format issued by Competent Authority as prescribed 
by Government of India in support of their claim. The name of the caste and community indicated in 
the OBC (NCL) certificate must appear in the central list of Other Backward Classes. In case, the 
candidate fails to produce his/her latest caste certificate in the prescribed format, his/ her candidature 
will not be considered. Further, OBC (NCL) candidates will have to give a self -undertaking indicating 
that they belong to OBC (NCL) category at the time of participating in the Document Verification cum 
Skill Test, if called for the same. 
 
13. Candidate seeking reservation under  EWS category should produce their latest Income and Asset 
Certificate issued by Competent Authority. The prescribed format and the Competent Authority have 
been given in Department of Personnel & Training, OM No. 36039/1/2019 -Estt (Res) dated 
31.01.2019. The EWS certificate issued by Competent Authority should be valid for the financial year 
2026-2027 and should have been prepared on the basis of income and asset verification for the 
financial year 2025-2026. Income and Asset Certificate shall be submitted  by such candidate at the 
time of Document Verification cum Skill Test  (if shortlisted). No request for extension of time for 
production of ‘Income & Asset Certificate’ beyond the said date shall be entertained. In case 
candidates fails to produce the same at the time of Document Verification, they will not be allowed to 
appear for Skill Test. Further, no request for change of category at a later stage of selection process 
will be entertained. 
 
14. Candidates presently employed in Central/ State Government, Autonomous bodies, PSUs may apply 
through 'Proper channel' or submit 'No Objection Certificate' at the time of Document Verification 
cum Skill Test from their employer.  
 
15. Applications that are not in conformity with the requirements indicated in this advertisement/ 
incomplete application will not be entertained. 
 
16. The candidature of applicants at all stages of selection process will be provisional and is subject to 
satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions. Mere issue of unique Roll number / Skill Test call letter 
to the candidate will not imply that his/her candidature has been finally cleared by BHEL.  
 
17. Candidates are advised to possess a valid e-mail ID, which is to be entered in the on-line Application 
Form.  They are also advised to retai n this e -mail ID active for at least one year as any important 
intimation to the candidates shall be provided by BHEL through e -mail. No separate communication 
shall be sent to the candidate by post. 
 
18. BHEL reserves the right to cancel/ restricts/enlarge/ r eopen the recruitment process, if the need so 
arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereof. 
 
19. Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement 
and/or an application in respons e thereto can be instituted only in the respective cities/towns where 
the units are located and the Courts / Tribunals / Forums (Jurisdiction Courts) at the place where units 
are located shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction. Like for example, for dis pute arising in Trichy, 
the jurisdiction shall rest with Madurai Bench of Madras High Court 
 
20. BHEL recruitment website https://careers.bhel.in will provide necessary details regarding, how to 
apply/ important dates / FAQs/ Skill Test call letters etc. It sh all be the responsibility of candidate to 
read the detailed instructions on the website and adhere to application requirements. Candidates are 
advised to visit the website https://careers.bhel.in regularly for updates. 
 
21. Such candidates from Armed Forces, who have been released/retired/discharged from Armed Forces 
and qualified as an Ex-servicemen are required to submit an undertaking {Form of Undertaking to be 
given by Candidates Applying for Civil Posts under Ex-Servicemen Category} duly signed by him/her 
stating that he/she has not secured any appointment on the civil side prior to this appointment along 
with his application at the time of Document verification. 
 
DIARY DATES: 
 
 
Milestones Scheduled Date* 
Opening of On-line submission of application 21st October, 2026 at 10:00 AM 
Closing of On-line submission of application 18th November, 2026 11:45 PM 
Tentative Date of Examination*  11th December, 2026 (Tentatively) 
 
*These dates are tentative and may undergo change. Any changes in this dates / other information 
shall be displayed on our website  https://careers.bhel.in

Dated: 26th October, 2026 
 
 
CORRIGENDUM 01/ 2026 (Ref. Advt 01/2026) 
 
 
With reference to Advertisement No. 01/2026, the cut -off date for acquiring the requisite 
ITI/NAC certificate(s)/marksheets shall stand revised from 01.10.2026 to the date of 
Document Verification  cum Skill Test . Candidates who fail to possess the requisit e 
certificate(s)/marksheets by the date of Document Verification shall be debarred from further 
participation in the selection process. 
  
 
संशोधन पत्र 01/2026 (संदर्भ: विज्ञापन 01/2026) 
 
विज्ञापन संख्या 01/2026 के संबंध में, आिश्यक ITI/NAC प्रमाणपत्र/अंकपत्र प्राप्त करने की अंततम ततथि 
को 01.10.2026 से बदलकर 'दस्तािेज़ सत्यापन सह कौशल परीक्षा' (Document Verification cum Skill 
Test) की ततथि कर ददया गया है। जो उम्मीदिार दस्तािेज़ सत्यापन की ततथि तक आिश्यक 
प्रमाणपत्र/अंकपत्र प्रस्तुत करने में विफल रहते हैं, उन्हें चयन प्रक्रिया में आगे भाग लेने से िंथचत कर ददया 
जाएगा। 
 
 
Ref: Advt. 01/2026 
BHARAT HEAVY ELECTRICALS LIMITED  
ARTISAN RECRUITMENT - 2027

Dated: 02nd November, 2026 
 
 
CORRIGENDUM 02/ 2026 (Ref. Advt 01/2026) 
 
 
With reference to Advertisement No. 01/2026, the qualification required for the notified post, 
i.e Xth Class with National Trade Certificate (NTC) & National Apprenticeship Certificate 
(NAC) shall include Xth Class with National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) acquired as ITI 
Training of two years followed by Apprenticeship Training of one year (e.g. Electrician trade) 
or directly completed the Apprenticeship Training of three years duration as fresher.  
 
For the above purpose, the candidates acquiring  National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC)  
as fresher, should fill the same marks in the ITI/  National Trade Certificate (NTC)  field and 
such candidates shall be considered equivalent to the qualification as notified in the 
Advertisement.  
  
 
 
 
संशोधन पत्र 02/2026 (संदर्भ: विज्ञापन 01/2026) 
 
विज्ञापन संख्या 01/2026 क े  संबंध में, अधिसूधित पद के धिए आवश्यक योग्यता (यानी 10वीीं कक्षा के साथ 
नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) और नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC)) में धनम्नधिखित भी शाधमि होींगे: 
10वीीं कक्षा के साथ नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) - धिसे या तो दो साि की ITI ट्रेधनींग और उसक े 
बाद एक साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग (उदाहरण के धिए, इिेक्ट्रीधशयन ट्रेड) के माध्यम से प्राप्त धकया गया हो, 
या धिर सीिे फ्र े शर के तौर पर तीन साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग पूरी करके प्राप्त धकया गया हो। 
 
इस उद्देश्य के धिए, िो उम्मीदवार फ्र े शर के तौर पर नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) प्राप्त करते हैं, 
उन्हें ITI/नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) वािे कॉिम में वही अींक भरने होींगे | ऐसे उम्मीदवारोीं को धवज्ञापन में 
बताई गई योग्यता के समकक्ष माना िाएगा। 
 
 
Ref: Advt. 01/2026 
BHARAT HEAVY ELECTRICALS LIMITED  
ARTISAN RECRUITMENT - 2027

items.doc_text:
Advt.No.01/2026 
Recruitment of “Artisan Grade – IV” 
 
COMPASSIONATE CONSIDERATION  
Consideration of Dependents of Deceased Employees on Compassionate Grounds:  
  
• Applications are invited from dependents of deceased BHEL employees to be considered 
for the post of “Artisan Grade – IV” on Compassionate Grounds.   
  
• For this purpose, up to 15% of the vacancies are earmarked for dependents of the 
deceased employees of BHEL. Unfilled vacancies, if any, shall later be shifted to open 
vacancies.   
  
• Age relaxation up to a maximum of 5 years will be allowed under this category.     
  
• A deceased employee is one who expired while in service with BHEL. His/her dependents 
mean his/her spouse & children.  
 
• Candidates can apply under the compassionate ground category only if he/ she or any 
of the other dependents (spouse and children) of deceased employee are not employed 
in Government / Semi-Government/ Autonomous Body/ PSU/ Organization listed on the 
Stock Exchange. 
  
• Candidates applying under this category will also have to go through the normal 
procedure of submission of application on-line, payment of fee, appearing for Computer 
Based Examination etc. as prescribed for other candidates.  
  
• In addition, candidates applying under this category will have to provide details about 
the deceased employee of BHEL in on-line application form.  
 
• Particulars furnished by such candidates shall be verified from the Unit where the 
deceased employee last worked. In case the particulars furnished are 
incorrect/dependents are employed elsewhere, the candidature will not be considered 
under Compassionate ground category and shall be shifted to open category.     
• Such Candidates will be accorded following relaxation in CBE Exam cut - off marks for 
being called for Document Verification/ Scrutiny Stage: 
 
 
 
 
• Since all other requirements are same as prescribed for other candidates, candidates 
applying under this category may thoroughly go through the complete web-site before 
applying.

and minimum expansion 5 cms. The range of expansion up to 4 cms. i.e. a deviation of 20% will     
be acceptable. This is not applicable to female candidates.  
 b)     Measurement: The candidate will stand with feet together and  arms raised over the head. Thetape 
will be taken around the chest horizontally with its upper edge touching the inferior angles o f the 
shoulder blades. The arms will then be lowered to hang relaxed by the side of the body. The 
candidate will not be permitted to throw shoulders upwards or backwards so as to displace the tape. 
The candidate will be directed to take the breath several times without causing contraction of chest 
or wing out the shoulder blades. The chest measurement at minimum and maximum expansion will 
 
be recorded in centimeters thus 7075, 78-84, etc. Fraction of cm below 0.5 will be ignored and over 
0.5 taken as 1.  
ii) Height measurement will be taken in centimeters with the individual standing barefooted and weight 
thrown on both heels kept together. Tendency to stand on toes or raised heels will be strictly avoided. 
The candidate will stand erect with chin drawn in to bring the vertex of the head in level under the 
horizontal bar of the stand and heels, calves, buttocks and shoulders touching the vertical portion of the 
stand with body fully relaxed and spine straight but not strained.  
  
iii) A Staff Nurse or Ayah will be present when female candidates are examined.  
  
    
7. Eye  
 Standards and procedures of examination in respect of visual acuity and colour perception are as 
follows :  
The candidate's eyes will be tested and results of the test recorded in accordance with the following 
rules :        
7.1 The candidate's eyes will be submitted to a general examination directed to the detection of any disease 
or abnormality. The candidate may be rejected if he suffers from morbid condition of the eyes, eyelids 
or contiguous structures of such nature as would render him/ her unfit for service at the time of 
appointment or at a future date.  
7.2 Visual Acuity The examination for determining the acuit y of vision includes two tests, one for distant, 
and the other for near vision. Each eye will be examined separately.  
7.3 Standard of visual acuity for personnel of various categories with or without glasses will be as follows :  
  Category of                   Age       Distant Vision                     Near Vision  
  Employees                     Better Eye     Worse Eye         Better Eye      Worse Eye  
 
 For Employees in E1 &     Below 35       6/9                6/9                   Sn.0.6             Sn.0.6  
 above and security and       yrs.              6/6              6/12  
 fire services personnel 
                                                        35 yrs. &       6/12            6/12                  Sn.0.8             Sn.0.8  
                                                         above           6/9              6/18  
              Others                           Below 35         6/9              6/24                Sn.0.6             Sn.0.8.  
                                                         yrs                6/18            6/18  
 
                               35 yrs. &  6/12         6/36        Sn.0.8       Sn.0.8  
                                                       above  6/24          6/24  
7.4 Fundus Examination  
 In every case of Myopia, Fundus examination should be carried out and the results recorded. In the 
event of a pathological condition being present which is likely to be progressive and affect the efficiency 
of the candidate, he/she should be declared unfit.  
  The total amount of Myopia ( including the cylinder ) shall not exceed - 6.00 D.   
7.5 Fundus and Media should be healthy and within normal limits.  
 
       
 
8.   
  
Ear  
The category of employees, who are covered under any applicable act prescribing certain 
standards of hearing should be examined by ENT specialist and should be submitted 
desirably for Audiometry examination.   
7.6   No degenerative signs of vitreous or chorioretinitis to be present suggesting progressive Myopia.  
7.7   Should have good binocular vision, fusion faculty and full field of vision in both the eyes.  
7.8  There should be no organic disease likely to cause exacerbations or deterioration.  
7.9   The field of vision shall be tested by the confrontation method. Where such test gives 
unsatisfactory or doubtful results , the field of vision should be determined on the visual field 
screen /perimeter.  
7.10   Ocular conditions other than visual acuity-Colour vision deficiency  
7.10.1  The testing of colour vision shall be essential for all candidates. Colour vision shall be tested with 
Ishihara's Isochromatic plates only in good light.  
7.10.2  Colour vision deficiency is a disqualification for the following :  
1. Painter   
2. Electricians   
3. Technicians engaged in Laboratory work and Chemists.   
4. Crane Operators and Points men.   
5. Draughtsmen.   
6. Drivers of all categories.   
7. Scientific Assistants.   
8. Security Personnel.   
9. Doctors.   
Other occupations where perception of colours is considered essential - Such cases with colour 
deficiency will be referred to concerned GM for his opinion and if recommended by him that this 
colour vision deficiency will not adversely affect the performanc e of the candidate, then the 
candidate may be declared medically fit by Medical Department provided however, that he 
otherwise declared medically fit in all other aspects.   
  
7.10.3   Whenever an employee suffering from colour blindness is posted or transferred into a category 
wherein colour perception is required, his eyes will be re-examined for the same along with the 
examination for visual acuity.  
7.11 Night blindness need not be tested as a routine but only in special cases. No standard test for the 
testing of night blindness or dark adaptation is prescribed. The Medical Officer will have the 
discretion to improvise such rough test e.g. recording of visual acuity with reduced illumination or 
by making the candidate recognize various objects in a dark room after he/she has been there for 
20 to 30 minutes. Candidates' own statements should not always be relied upon, but they should 
be given due consideration.  
7.12 Any organic disease or a progressive refractive error which is likely to result in lowering of the visual 
acuity shall be considered as a disqualification.  
7.13 For technical services/skilled jobs, squint in presence of normal binocular vision should not be 
considered a disqualification. For other services, the presence of squint should not be considered 
as a disqualification if the visual acuity of each eye is of the prescribed standard.  
7.14 For regular service one eyed individual should be considered as unfit ex cept for ministerial and 
allied jobs where a binocular vision is not considered essential. It will be ensured that the prognosis 
of the functioning eye is good and its vision is not likely to be endangered by the condition of the 
worse eye and the prescribed visual acuity standards are fully satisfied.  
7.18   Correction with contact lenses is no bar for employment provided the prescribed standards are 
fulfilled.  
  
  
    
 
9.   
  
Nose  
A candidate should be free from any active disease of nose.  
10.   
  
 
Throat  
State of tonsils-Slight hypertrophy without evidence of repeated tonsilitis is not a cause for 
rejection. Enlarged tonsils cause temporary unfitness until treated with tonsillectomy. 
Throat, palate, gums, jaws temporo-mandibular joints and dentition should be within 
normal limits.  
Blood Pressure (BP)  
BP recording of 140/90 mm Hg can be considered as the upper limit for fitness.  
- The measurement of BP should be accurate and has to be done both in lying and the 
sitting posture.  
  
(b)  If any candidate has a BP reading of more than this level they be re-examined three times 
at different interval and if the reading continues to be 140/90 mm Hg or higher, then   
   
(i) For candidates 35 yrs. or less of age - this is Hypertension and the candidate is to be 
declared UNFIT.  
  
(ii)For candidates above 35 yrs. of age, this is Hypertension but candidate can be 
declared FIT, provided there is no end organ damage. Tests for end organ damage would 
remain the same as in the case with Diabetes Mellitus.   
      
(c)      
During Medical Examination of new inductees who are above the age of 35 yrs., the 
following additional tests are to be conducted  
- TMT  
- ECHO  
- Ultrasound whole abdomen  
  
TMT positive for reversible ischemia will render the candidate UNFIT for employment. 
However, if he gets Coronary Angiography done at his own cost at BHEL approved 
hospitals/AIIMS, and Coronary angiography is normal, then he can be considered FIT for 
employment.  
For any findings detected in ECHO or Ultrasound whole abdomen, appropriate decision 
will be taken by Company Medical Officer.  
11.2   The blood pressure will be recorded in mm of mercury, with a sphygmomanometer after 
the candidate has rested in a quiet room on an examination couch for a minimum of 15 
minutes.   
11.3   
  
Method of taking blood pressure  
The mercury manometer type of instrument should be used as a rule. The measurement 
should not be taken within 15 minutes of any exercise or excitement, provided the 
candidate and particularly the arm is relaxed either lying or sitting. The arm is supported  
comfortably at the side in a more or less horizontal position. The arm should be freed from 
clothes to the shoulder. The cuff completely deflated should be applied with the middle of 
the rubber over the inner side of the arm and its lower edge an inch or two above the bent 
of the elbow. The turns of cloth bandages should spread evenly over the bag to avoid 
bulging inflation. The cuff is again inflated to 30 to 40 mm above this reading (i.e. 140 mm 
Hg). The brachial artery is located by palpation at the ben d of the elbow and the 
stethoscope is then applied snugly and centrally over it below but not in contact with the 
cuff. The cuff is inflated to the above mentioned level and deflated slowly. The level of  
 
 

 
  
  
the mercury column when soft successive sounds appear represents the systolic pressure. 
When more air is allowed to escape, the sounds will be heard to increase in intensity. The 
level of the column at which the well heard sounds change to soft muffled fad ing sounds, 
represents the diastolic pressure. The measurements should be taken in a fairly brief time 
as prolonged pressure of the cuff is irritating to the individual and will vitiate the readings. 
Rechecking, if necessary should be done only a few minutes after complete deflation of 
the cuff.   
12. Glands   
  Thyroid should be normal with no evidence of hypo or hyper thyroidism or generalised enlargement 
of lymph glands. Scars if any, of the previous removal of tubercular glands should be normal and 
there must not have been any active disease in the last five years.  
13. Urine   
A  “Non orthostatic albuminuria will be a cause of rejection. If sugar is detected during routine chemical 
tests, further laboratory tests such as standard blood sugar tolerance test will be undertaken by a 
Medical Specialist before determining the fitnessï”.  
B      Diabetes Mellitus  
- To investigate the presence of Diabetes Mellitus, three blood tests should be conducted for all 
candidates inducted in the Company viz., (1) fasting Blood Sugar, (2) post-prandial Blood Sugar 
and (3) Glycosylated Haemoglobin (Hb A1C).   
       Upto 35 yrs. of Age   
If there is no History of Diabetes and results of the above mentioned tests are within permissible 
limits, the candidate will be declared FIT. For all other cases, a candidate is to be declared as Unfit.   
       Above 35 yrs. of Age  
- A candidate with a BMI of less than or equal to 25, may be declared FIT, even if suffering from 
Diabetes Mellitus (to be ascertained as per the above three tests), provided there is no End Organ 
Damage*.  
*End Organ Damage pertains to Heart, Brain, Kidney, Eye & Peripheral Vascular System. Following 
tests to be conducted to determine end organ damage:  i) Eye - Fundus Examination and FFA.  
ii) Kidney - Micro Albuminuria, Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea.  
iii) Heart - Echo, TMT, ECG  
  
If for a candidate TMT result is positive, then no more tests are to be conducted and the candidate 
is to be declared UNFIT.  
  
- If (a) BMI is >25, (b) age is above 35 years and (c) candidate is also suffering from Diabetes  
Mellitus, then no end organ tests are to be conducted and the candidate is to be declared UNFIT.  
   Diagnostic Criteria   
-   sting Plasma Glucose) ≥ 126 mg% or ≥ 7.0 m.mol/ L  
OR  
- RBS (Random Blood Sugar) ≥ 200 mg%  
or ≥ 11.1 m.mol/ L / 2 Hr. Plasma Glucose during an Oral GTT (Glucose Tolerance Test) ≥ 200 
mg% or ≥ 11.1 m.mol/ L  
OR  
- (Hb A1C) > 6.5%   
  
All the three above tests are to be done and if the result of even one test is positive, the candidate 
will be diagnosed as having Diabetes.  
   
FPG (Fa 
 
14.   
  
Radiological Examination   
Skiagram chest of all fresh entrants will be taken. Mass miniature radiography will be utilised, 
wherever available. Cases diagnosed as suffering from pulmonary tuberculosis will be declared 
temporarily unfit for a period of 3 months. On completion of this period, the candidate will be 
reexamined with regard to medical fitness.  
 
15.    
  
Venereal Diseases   
Candidates who have suffered or are suffering from venereal diseases will not be declared fit 
unless detailed examination of urethral smear and serological test proves negative.   
 
16.   
    
Skin Diseases  Candidates suffering from leprosy or chronic skin conditions will be declared 
unfit. Vitiligo cases are acceptable.  
17.  
    
 Fits  
Candidates suffering from epilepsy will be declared unfit in certain occupations like drivers, crane 
operators, machinists, fire brigade , security duties and shop floor jobs where moving machinery 
may cause risk to life if they suffer from a fit in the vicinity.  
18.    
  
Miscellaneous  
Sign of mental retardation, incontinence of urine or enureses at the time of pre -employment 
medical examination will render a candidate unfit.  
19.   
  
Pregnancy  
If at the time of medical examination, a candidate is pregnant of 12 weeks or more she shall be 
declared temporarily unfit until she has completed 6 weeks after confinement. After confinement 
the candidate shall be required to produce a medical certificate of fitness from a  registered 
medical practitioner before being called for a final medical examination.  
20.   
  
Defects  
Congenital or acquired physical defects if any noticed will be recorded on the medical examination 
form with a clear opinion as to whether it is likely to interfere with the efficient performance of the 
duties for which the candidate is under consideration for employment.

items.title: FAQs-Updated
items.doc_text:
BHEL Artisans Recruitment 2027 
Frequently Asked Questions 
S/n Query Reply 
1 I have done ITI in Electric ian 
Trade & also done ITI in 
Electronics Mechanic Trade, am 
I eligible to apply for both the 
positions? 
 
I have done ITI in Welder Trade 
& also done ITI in Fitter Trade, 
am I eligible to apply for both the 
positions? 
The requirement of BHEL position is specific as per qualification 
mentioned in the detailed advertisement. 
 
In such as case, candidate, may be eligible to apply for both the 
positions. However, candidates must carefully choose to apply to 
Manufacturing Unit of their preference, against vacancies available 
in their respective trades, as candidate can apply against vacancies 
of ONE unit & ONE trade only. 
 
Candidates should refrain from applying to multiple positions and 
different units. 
2 I have completed my 
apprenticeship and the 
Apprenticeship Certificate is yet 
to be received. Am I eligible to 
apply for BHEL Artisan-2027? 
Candidates must ensure that their ITI & NAC Certificates and marks 
sheets are valid as on 1st October, 2026. Any marksheets issued on 
a later date shall not be considered for eligibility. 
3 I have studied Diploma in 
Electrical Engineering. Am I 
eligible to apply against this 
advertisement? 
Candidates    with    higher qualifications or not possessing requisite 
qualifications as per notification are not eligible to apply. 
 
4.  I am meeting all requirements 
with respect to Qualifications 
belonging to the General 
Category. However, I will be 27 
years and 5 days old on 01-
October-2026. Am I eligible to 
apply? 
Candidates belonging to General category and not claiming any 
other age relaxation, born before 01 -October-1999 are not eligible 
to apply. 
(For age relaxation candidate may refer our detailed online 
advertisement) 
5. I am meeting all requirements 
with respect to Qualifications 
and over age by 3 Months. 
However, I have 3 Months work 
experience certificate. Am I 
eligible to apply? 
Age Relaxation on account of experience to candidate shall be 
given for minimum of 6 Months of service and up to a maximum of 
7 years. 
(For age relaxation candidate may refer our detailed online 
advertisement) 
6. I am a SC/ST/OBC candidate 
but don't have the caste 
certificate, can I apply as a 
General candidate? 
If you so desire, you may apply as General Candidate (if eligible for 
Gen category) giving your category as "Gen". In such an event, your 
candidature will be considered as "GEN" and no change in category 
shall be allowed at a later date. 
7. Will any Travelling Allowance be 
paid to  me for attending the 
COMPUTER BASED 
EXAMINATION? 
No Travelling Allowance is payable to the candidates for attending 
the COMPUTER BASED EXAMINATION. You will have to attend 
the COMPUTER BASED EXAMINATION at your own expense. 
8. Will any Travelling Allowance be 
paid to me for attending the Skill 
Test, as applicable? 
Candidates shortlisted for Skill Test Stage shall be reimbursed 
second sleeper train fare as per rules. However, at this stage, if it is 
found that the candidate does not fulfil any of th e eligibility 
conditions, they will neither be allowed for the Skill Test / Document 
Verification Stage nor paid any Travelling Allowance. 
9. I am a “ST” category candidate 
applying for “Turner” trade in 
BAP Ranipet but the online 
application system is no t 
allowing me 5 -year age 
relaxation? 
Age relaxation is provided to reserved social category candidates 
only for the trades having earmarked vacancies for their respective 
categories.  
 
Since, Turner trade in BAP Ranipet  is not reserved for “ST” 
candidates – they may apply under “UR” category . However, they 
will not get age relaxation as applicable to ST category.  
 
10. I am an ex-serviceman and have 
already availed reservation as 
ex-serviceman for securing job 
on civil side. Am I eligible to avail 
reservation? 
Ex-servicemen who have already secured employment in civil side 
under Government in Group ‘C’ posts on regular basis after availing 
benefits of reservation given to ex -servicemen for their re -
employment are not eligible for reservation in ESM category. 
11. I am an ex-serviceman and have 
army issued certificate of trade 
1172 1173 &1176, will it be 
acceptable? 
Ex-servicemen claiming equivalence in qualification shall be 
required to produce a copy of equivalence certificate in respect of 
the relevant “trade” applied for. 
12. I am a “Best Apprentice” 
candidate. How do I confirm that 
I get the consideration as 
mentioned in the advertisement? 
Candidates shall be necessarily required to Upload their “Certificate 
of Merit” of Best Apprentice/ Runner-Up Apprentice in the All India 
Apprentices Competition issued by Directorate General of 
Employment and Training.  
No other form of certificate shall be applicable. 
13. I have done ITI in “Turner” trade. 
My original application has an 
error and wrong declaration, so I 
applied again? Which 
application shall be considered? 
In case of multiple applications from the same candidates for same 
trade and unit, only the last submitted application shall be 
considered for candidature.  
14. I have done ITI in “Electrician” & 
“Electronics Mechanic” trades. 
Can I apply against both 
vacancies? Which application 
shall be considered? 
BHEL encourages candidates to apply against vacancies of ONE 
unit & ONE trade only. However, in case a  candidate applies to 
two different trades, admit cards shall be issued for both trades and 
CBE will happen on same day, so further candidature shall be 
considered on merit and performance in CBE of the trade in which 
candidate chooses to appear. 
15. I have done ITI in “Fitter” trade 
and wish to apply for vacancies 
in both BAP and HPVP. Will I be 
considered at both the 
locations? 
BHEL encourages candidates to apply against vacancies of ONE 
unit & ONE trade only. However, in case a candidate applies to 
two different units, admit cards shall be issued for both units and 
CBE will happen on same day, so further candidature shall be 
considered on merit and performance in CBE. 
16. Is there a minimum cut -off for 
Computer Based Examination? 
There shall be a mini mum qualifying mark in the Computer Based 
Examination (CBE) of 40% Marks for UR or EWS Category & 30% 
Marks for OBC (Non -Creamy Layer)/SC/ST Categories. Any 
candidate scoring below the minimum qualifying marks in Computer 
Based Examination (CBE) shall be d isqualified from further 
selection process. 
PwD candidates & Ex -Servicemen candidates will be accorded 
relaxation below the cut-off marks in respective categories (limited 
to minimum qualifying of 30 Marks for UR/EWS and minimum 
qualifying of 22.5 Marks fo r OBC/SC & ST Categories) for being 
shortlisted for Skill Test in the similar prescribed ratio of 1:3 or a 
maximum of 5 candidates in case of single vacancy. 
17. I am a PWD Candidate. Will I be 
allowed to get a “Scribe”? 
Scribe facility shall be available  for persons with benchmark 
disabilities in the category of locomotor disability and any other 
identified benchmark disability, provided that candidate produces 
original medical certificate and physical limitation certificate (format 
on website https://car eers.bhel.in), issued by competent medical 
authority regarding such disability at the time of entry to 
examination centre (as per government guidelines). 
 
 
18. Where is my answer key? The answer key and objection management facility will be made 
available through the respective individual candidate’s Login portals 19. When does the Objection 
Management Window Open? 
 
20. How can I appeal against any 
Question in the Computer Based 
Examination (CBE)? 
shortly after the conduct of the Computer Based Examination 
(CBE). 
 
Objection management window is opened after upto 5 Days from 
the Date of Computer Based Examination (CBE), wherein any  
candidate can view the Question Set, Answer Key and their 
selected options and can raise an appeal against any question.  
 
Since, this is a CBE, this information is not available post expiry of 
Objection Management Window, therefore interested candidates 
may download or retain a printout of their answer copy for their own 
use. 
 
Therefore, applicants are advised to the BHEL Recruitment website 
– careers.bhel.in periodically for important updates. 
21. Where can I download my 
question paper? 
22. Where is the skill test result? The Skill Test Results will be hosted on the respective Unit ’s 
website. The relevant URLs for accessing the results will be 
provided post completion of Skill Test for all candidates at the 
respective Unit. 
23. Where is the final cut off? The final cut-off will be published in the respective Unit ’s website. 
Candidates may access the final cut -off through the same URL 
provided for Skill Test results of the respective Unit. The links will 
also be available on the BHEL Careers Portal. 
24 My email ID is inactive. How will 
I get provisional offer and 
updates? 
Candidates are advised to keep the email ID (to be entered 
compulsorily in the application form) active for at least one year. No 
change in the email ID will be allowed once entered. All 
correspondence with candidates shall be done through email only. 
Responsibilities of receiving and downloading of 
information/communications etc. will be of the candidate. BHEL will 
not be responsible for bouncing of e -mails, non-receipt of e -mails 
due to invalid e-mail IDs, setting options exercised by the candidate, 
etc. and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained. 
25 Can I get by Computer Based 
Examination center changed 
after submission of application 
form ? 
No request for change of city of examination/examination centre will 
be entertained after submission of application form. 
26 When will Admit card be issued / 
Examination City informed to 
me? 
Examination city shall be informed around 7 days before the date 
of Computer Based Examination. 
27 I am a “Temporary Employee” at 
BHEL selected in Artisa n 
Recruitment – 2026. Am I 
eligible for this post? 
Candidates who have already been selected/engaged as 
Temporary Employees or for any other post  and presently not 
regularized or on probation in BHEL shall not be eligible to apply for 
the present recruitment and their candidature shall not considered. 
28 What is the ratio of calling the 
candidate for the Skill test? 
Details of shortlisting criteria and prescribed ratio is mentioned 
in the detailed notification for the position. 
29 What are the directives 
regarding recruitment of SC / ST, 
OBC, PwD, EWS, Women and 
Minorities? 
BHEL adheres to all applicable DPE Guidelines / Presidential 
Directives issued by the Central  Govt., i.r.o SC/ST, OBC, PwD, 
EWS, Women and Minorities in the matters pertainin g to 
recruitment in BHEL. 
30 I work in a Public Sector 
Undertaking / Central 
government / State Government 
and wish to apply for BHEL 
Artisan vacancies. Will I require 
a NOC? 
Candidates presently employed in Central/ State Government, 
Autonomous bodies, PSUs may apply through 'Proper channel' or 
submit 'No Objection Certificate'  at the time of Document 
Verification cum Skill Test from their employer. 
31 I have done “SCVT” and NAC. 
AM I eligible for Artisan Post? 
Only NCVT/ITI and NAC qualifications are prescribed essential 
qualifications and considered eligible for the Artisan Post.  
 
32 I have 1-year Work Experience 
as “Apprentice” and I am over 
age by 1 Year. Am I eligible to 
apply? 
As per the prescribed eligibility criteria, ITI & NAC is the essential  
criteria. Any Work Experience post obtaining NAC is eligible for Age 
relaxation subject to minimum 6 Months and Maximum 7 years. 
33 My NAC certificate shall be 
received in the month of 
November, 2026. Am I eligible to 
apply? 
Yes. As per corrigendum issued on 26.10.2026 - the cut-off date for 
acquiring the requisite ITI/NAC certificate(s)/marksheets shall stand 
revised from 01.10.2026 to the date of Document Verification cum 
Skill Test. 
34 I will be completing NAC in 
March, 2027. Am I eligible to 
apply?  
As per corrigendum issued on 26.10.2026 - the cut -off date for 
acquiring the requisite ITI/NAC certificate(s)/marksheets shall stand 
revised from 01.10.2026 to the date of Document Verification cum 
Skill Test. 
 
However, Candidates who fail to possess the requisite 
certificate(s)/marksheets by the date of Document Verification shall 
be debarred from further participation in the selection process. 
35 I have done ITI in welder trade 
after 8th class and did 10th after 
ITI. Am I eligible to apply? 
Yes, as long  as candidate meets the Age/Qualification and other 
eligibility criteria – Xth class passing post acquiring ITI is also 
acceptable.  
36 I have done ITI as ““Sheet Metal 
Worker” or “Blacksmith”. Am I 
eligible to apply for Foundryman 
trade? 
Artisan Recruitm ent notified vide Advertisement No. 01/2026, 
clearly stipulates the prescribed essential qualifications, terms and 
conditions relating to eligibility and other relevant provisions 
governing the recruitment. 
 
Only the notified posts/vacancies are considered for recruitment. 
37 I will be completing NAC in 
March, 2027. As per 
Corrigendum – I, I am eligible to 
apply, what do I fill as passin g 
date? 
For candidates completing their NAC on or after 1st October, 2026 
– such candidates must fill 1st October, 2026 as their exam passing 
date for consideration of their eligibility. 
38 I will be completing NAC in 
March, 2027. As per 
Corrigendum – I, I am eligible to 
apply, what do I fill as passin g 
Marks? 
For candidates completing their NAC on or after 1st October, 2026 
– such candidates must fill 60% marks for Gen & OBC candidates 
and 55% marks for SC & ST candidates  for consideration of their 
eligibility. The actual marks obtained shall be considered as per 
original certificates at the time of “Document Verification”.

Advt. No. CE-05/2026   
BHEL was incorporated in 1964 as a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) and since then the company has 
been at the forefront of powering India’s growth, serving as a trusted partner in nation -building and a 
leader in the capital goods sector. BHEL is backed by a robust manufacturing network comprising 15 
manufacturing units, 08 service centres, 15 Regional Marketing Centres, 04 Regional Offices and 02 
Repair Units. Combining world-class engineering, manufacturing, project execution expertise, and after -
sales support, BHEL serves a broad spectrum of sectors including power, transportation, defence, 
aerospace, oil & gas, and process industries with a significant cont ribution to India's power generation 
capacity across thermal, hydro, gas, nuclear, and solar segments. The Company has its footprint in all the 
6 inhabited continents with presence in 95 countries. BHEL continues to be a key enabler of the country's 
energy security, infrastructure development, and self -reliance objectives. Presently, the total order book 
stands at all time high of more than Rs. 2.6 Lakh Crores, reaffirming customer confidence and strong 
revenue visibility.  
  
BHEL invites applications for One Position of Associate Consultant/Sr. Associate Consultant/ Additional 
Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant /Consultant in the area of Steam Turbine Generator execution for 
STG project 1X250 MW STG & it’s Auxiliaries at JSW Dolvi, Maharastra and One Position of Associate 
Consultant/Sr. Associate Consultant/ Additional Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant /Consultant  in 
the area of Boiler execution for TPH Project 1X265 TPH BPCL, BINA. The position shall be based at JSW 
Dolvi, Maharastra & TPHBPCL, BINA or any other location as decided by BHEL management. The positions 
shall report to BHEL-HPEP, Hyderabad. 
 
Period of Engagement:     
The period of engagement for STG project 1X250 MW STG & it’s Auxiliaries at JSW Dolvi, Maharastra 
shall be for 13 months and period of engagement for TPH Project 1x265 TPH Boiler at BPCL, BINA shall 
be for 19 months , which can be further extended by a period of upto one year at a time or till the 
completion of assignment (whichever is earlier). On completion of the assignment, the services may be 
extended to other ongoing or upcoming projects based on requirement However, the maximum tenure 
shall be limited to five years or upto 65 years of age. (whichever is earlier). 
  
Job Description: 
 
(I) For STG Project at JSW Dolvi, Maharastra : 
 
 
The Associate Consultant/Sr. Associate Consultant/ Additional Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant 
/Consultant shall provide Professional Advice/Assistance to BHEL, HPEP, Hyderabad in the following 
areas: 
 
• Specialized knowledge and hands -on guidance to ensure timely and safe erection and 
commissioning of STG and its auxiliaries. 
• Performance commitments viz a viz quality, safety and troubleshooting capabilities. 
• Technical decision-making and faster problem resolution at site. 
• Erection, Alignment, Testing & commissioning of STG package. 
• Support in validating test results, documentation, and performance compliance. 
• Optimization of plant performance during PG testing and handover of STG Plant. 
• Review relevant engineering drawings & Scheduling the sequential activities. 
• Supervise and witness key erection and commissioning activities of STG. 

 
• Assist in troubleshooting and performance improvement. 
• Provide technical reports, observations, and recommendations. 
• Support in successful completion of PG Tests and final acceptance 
 
 
(II) For TPH Project at BPCL, BINA: 
 
The Associate Consultant/Sr. Associate Consultant/ Additional Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant 
/Consultant shall provide Professional Advice/Assistance to BHEL, HPEP, Hyderabad in the following 
areas: 
• Specialized knowledge and hands -on guidance to ensure timely and safe erection and 
commissioning of Boiler and its auxiliaries. 
• Performance commitments viz a viz quality, safety and troubleshooting capabilities. 
• Technical decision-making and faster problem resolution at site. 
• Erection, Alignment, Testing & commissioning of Boiler package. 
• Support in validating test results, documentation, and performance compliance. 
• Optimization of plant performance during PG testing and handover of Boiler Plant. 
• Review relevant engineering drawings & Scheduling the sequential activities. 
• Supervise and witness key erection and commissioning activities of Boiler. 
• Assist in troubleshooting and performance improvement. 
• Provide technical reports, observations, and recommendations. 
• Support in successful completion of PG Tests and final acceptance 
 
Eligibility Criteria: 
 
Any retired executive (BHEL equivalent grade of E4 to E7 ) from PSUs/Autonomous Organizations 
/Central/State Government / Statutory Bodies meeting following eligibility criteria can apply:   
(i) Age (as on 01st of September,2026): The applicant should not be more than 63 years.  
Note: Applicants retired under VRS Scheme shall be considered only after attaining 60 years of 
age*. 
* Exception for Ex -Servicemen for the lower age, however duration of engagement for Ex -
Servicemen shall be 05 years or till 65 years of age, whichever is earlier.    
 
(ii) Qualification Requirements:  
The applicant must possess BE/B.Tech/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering/Power Plant 
Engineering/Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized institute. 
 
(iii) Experience (as on 01st of September,2026) 
For STG Project at JSW Dolvi, Maharastra : 
Work Experience of minimum 15 years post Qualification in the field of Erection, Commissioning & 
PG Testing of Steam turbine generator execution and must have completed at least Erection & 
Commissioning of one STG unit of capacity 150 MW or more. 
For TPH Project at BPCL, BINA: 
Work Experience of minimum 15 years post Qualification in the field of Erection, Commissioning & 
PG Testing of Boiler execution and must have completed at least Erection & Commissioning of one 
Boiler unit of capacity 100 MW plant capacity or more 
 
Selection Process: 
 
The applications, received against the notification, will be scrutinized by a committee and the shortlisted 
candidates may be then called for an interaction, if required, by a duly constituted Selection Board.  
 
 
The outside candidates called for the interaction shall be reimbursed the travel expenses as given below: 
By Rail: AC-First Class or By Air: By Economy Class Air fare or By Road: Actuals, limited to train fare 
 
 
 
Emoluments:  
 
BHEL equivalent 
Cadre / Grade from 
which retired 
Designation Consultancy fee (Rs./month) 
E4  Associate Consultant 75,000 
E5  Senior Associate Consultant 84,000  
E6  Additional Consultant  90,000  
E6A Senior Additional Consultant 1,00,000  
E7  Consultant  1,05,000  
In addition, he/she will be eligible for mobile phone charges (Up to Rs 2000) for one connection, HRA as 
per applicable rates, Transport Allowance shall be provided. He/ She will be eligible for TA/DA while on 
tour. The Associate Consultant/Sr. Associate Consultant/ Additional Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant 
/Consultant posted at sites shall be eligible for payment of site allowance at 20% of consultancy fees. 
 
Confidentiality-cum-Non-Disclosure agreement: 
The Associate Consultant/Sr. Associate Consultant/ Additional Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant 
/Consultant who are bound by the Confidentiality-cum-Non-Disclosure agreements with their previous 
employer is not eligible to apply. Further will have to sign Confidentiality-cum-Non-Disclosure agreements 
with BHEL. 
 
General Instructions:   
 
1. Applications that are not in conformity with requirements indicated in the advertisement/incomplete 
applications will not be entertained.  
2. The candidature of applicants a t all stages of selection process will be provisional and is subject 
to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions.  
3. Candidates/Applicants, who have undergone any major punishment shall not be eligible.   
4. BHEL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/re open/increase the number of vacancies for  the 
engagement, if the need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason 
thereof.  
5. Applicants should only apply online at www.careers.bhel.in. The application submission is in two 
stages. In the first stage, applicant has to fill in the required details as per form. Thereafter, a 
private login on the link “Latest Status” would be created, wherein the applicant would be 
required to upload the necessary documents.     
The complete application form should comprise of the following:   
a. Letter of Interest (LoI) for the said position.   
b. Necessary documents to substantiate Eligibility details as referred in Application form, 
including DOB Proof , Relevant Qualification, Comprehensive Biodata and Service 
certificate/ Experience Certificate(s).  
6. The applicant must ensure that the status of both the stages of application form is reflected as 
“COMPLETED”. Only then, the application form will be considered for candidature.   
7. Responsibility of uploading the necessary documents shall be with the Applicant. The applicant can 
view the documents uploaded in their login. Maximum Size of the document to be uploaded has 
been described against the upload link. BHEL does not take respon sibility of attaching the 
documents separately or receiving them in any subsequent mail.  
 
8. The uploaded documents shall be in legible form- i.e. the contents should be readable. Upload of 
blurred/edited images will lead to disqualification of the candidature.   
9. No hard copy application shall be entertained.  
10. Applicants must keep their E -mail ID (from which the applicant is submitted at BHEL) active for at 
least 6 months as any important intimation/notice with regards to this notification shall be provided 
by BHEL through e -Mail. They are further requested to check their e -mail for any communication 
from BHEL in this regard.  
11. Vigilance clearance shall be obtained in respect of  The Associa te Consultant/Sr. Associate 
Consultant/ Additional Consultant/Sr. Additional Consultant /Consultant  before issue of Offer of 
Engagement for the applicant retired from Central / State PSUs, Autonomous Organizations of 
Central / State PSUs and retired office rs belonging to All India Services, Group “A” officers of 
Central/State Govt or their equivalent in other organizations owned or controlled by Central/State 
Government.

items.doc_text: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited Powering Progress, Brightening Lives Touching Every Indian Home Welcome to the Online Application for the Post of Hindi Translator on FTA Basis Home Advertisement Requirements Job Specifications Selection Process Remuneration General Instructions How to Apply Apply Online Important Dates Latest Status BHEL , India’s Premier Engineering Organisation provides world class products and services for the core sectors of Indian economy viz., Power Generation and Transmission, Industry, Transportation, Oil and Gas, Renewable Energy, Defence etc. It has a wide network of 16 manufacturing divisions, 4 Power Sector Regional Centres, 8 Service Centres, 15 Regional Offices, 4 Overseas Offices and a large number of project sites spread across the country and abroad. BHEL, Power Sector – Southern Region is looking for Rajbhasha Anuvadak (Hindi Translator) to be engaged purely on Fixed Tenure Basis for its Head Quarters at Chennai as per details given below: Post Nos. Minimum Experience Upper Age Limit (As on 01.10.2026) All-inclusive consolidated compensation per month Tenure FTA Grade III Rajbhasha Anuvadak (Hindi Translator) 01 (Unreserved) 02 years 34 years Rs.45,000/- 1st Year, Rs.48,000/- 2nd Year 2 years or completion of Assignments whichever is earlier Milestones Scheduled Date Commencement of Online Submission of Applications 30.10.2026 Closing of Online Submission of Applications 01.12.2026 Last date for receipt of filled-in and signed application form at BHEL - PSSR, Chennai 07.12.2026 Last date for receipt of filled-in and signed application form at BHEL - PSSR, Chennai from far flung areas 15.12.2026 For any Queries/Technical Assistance mail to pssr.recruit@bhel.in

Ref No. BHEL/ AA/HR/PTMC/2026                                                    Dated: 13.10.2026 
 
Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited, Corporate Office, New Delhi is looking out for 
ENGAGEMENT OF PART TIME MEDICAL CONSULTANT (MBBS) 
 
1. Number of posts:  Two Nos. (PTMC-MBBSS with one -year experience) for Delhi / 
NCR Dispensaries 
 
2. Qualification and Emoluments:  
Post No. of 
Vacancy 
Minimum Qualification  Post 
Qualification 
Experience 
Emoluments per hour 
(INR) 
PTMC-
MBBS 
Two MBBS One-year 500/- 
 
3. Duration of work: 2 - 6 hours on all working days 
 
4. Engagement Period: The terms of a PTMC will be one year at the time of initial 
appointment. Subsequent renewal(s) will be for a period of maximum three years, at 
the discretion of the management. There will be one -month notice period, on either 
side. 
 
5. Upper Age Limit:  Not more than 6 5 years of age as on 01.10.2026. Age can be 
relaxed up to 70 years with specific approval of the management. 
 
6. Conveyance Charges: On actual basis, with upper ceiling of Rs. 4500/- p.m. (upto 
30 kms. one way) or for long-distance travel (beyond 30 kms. one way), upper ceiling 
limit of Rs. 6000/- p.m. on case to case basis. 
 
7. Selection: Through walk-in interview of eligible  candidates fulfilling the minimum 
eligibility criteria. Selection will be based on verification of Original Certificates and 
performance in Personal Interview. 
 
8. Medical Fitness: The selected candidate would undergo medical fitness test at BHEL 
Dispensary at the time of joining. 
 
9. How to Apply:  
 
 
a) Interested candidates are required to walk-in for Personal Interview on 22.10. 2026 
between 09.30 AM to 12.30 PM at Ground Floor Conference Room, BHEL House, 
Siri Fort, New Delhi-49. 
 
b)  Interested candidates are required to bring the following documents (original and 
a photocopy) for verification at the time of interview:  
1. Duly filled in Bio-Data Form (Proforma available at https://careers.bhel.in) along 
with two latest passport size photographs.  
2. High School Marksheet and Certificate (As proof of Date of Birth)  
3. Intermediate Marksheet and Certificate  
4. MBBS Certificate with all Semester Marksheets, Internship Certificate, and Post-
Qualification Experience Certificate 
5. Valid Registration Certificate (in respect of Specialization) issued by the Medical 
Council of India or by a State Medical Council. 
 
10.   General Instructions: 
 
a) No TA/ DA would be paid to candidates for appearing for the interview. 
 
b) The candidates should ensure while appearing for walk-in interview that they fulfil 
the essential eligibility criteria and  other requirements prescribed for the above 
posts and that the particulars furnished by them are correct in all respects. In case, 
it is detected at any stage of recruitment process that the  candidates do not fulfil 
the essential eligibility criteria and /or does not comply with other requirements and 
/or he/she has furnished any incorrect / false information or has suppressed  any 
relevant information / material fact(s), his / her candidature is liable to be rejected. 
If any of the above shortcomings is/are detected, even after appointment, his/her 
services are liable for suitable action including termination and prosecution. 
 
c) The Management reserves the right to Revise / Reschedule / Cancel /  Suspend 
the recruitment process, if the need so arises, without assigning any further notice 
or reason thereof. The  decision of the management shall be final and no appeal 
shall be entertained. The Company  reserves the right to reject any application 
without assigning any reason whatsoever. 
 
d)  Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of 
this advertisement and /or an application in response thereto can be instituted only 
in Delhi and Courts/Tribunals/Forums (Jurisdiction Courts) at Delhi only shall have 
sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any such cause / dispute. 
 
e) Management reserves the right to disqualify any candidate who is unable to 
produce relevant documents in proof of qualification  & required experience . No 
correspondence in this regard shall be entertained. 
 
f) Candidates are advised to possess a valid e -mail ID. They are also advised to 
keep this e -mail ID  active for a period of minimum one year , as any important 
intimation to them shall be provided by BHEL through e-mail.

of attendance, subject to the maximum limits prescribed in the policy. 
 
On consideration the local conditions w.r.t distance, Part Time Medical Consultants, who 
will be finally engaged initially for a period of one year, may be given conveyance charges 
as per the following during their period of engagement: 
 
a) In case of Local travel ( up to 30kms one way ), conveyance charges may be given on 
actual basis linked with biometric attendance verified by medical department, with the 
upper ceiling of Rs. 4500 per month. 
 
(b) Where long distance travel, beyond (30 kms one way) is involved, conveyance charges 
may be given on actual basis, with the upper ceiling of Rs. 6000/ - per month, on case to 
case basis. 
 
IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS 
 
• Candidates applying for the above posts shall have all their Degrees 
(MBBS/MD/MD/MS/DNB/MDS/PG Diploma recognized by the Medical 
Council of India. 
 
• Candidates applying for the above posts must register all their Degrees with 
Medical Council of India/State Medical Council.

Interview along with application in the prescribed and relevant 
documents/testimonials in support of eligibility in original & one set photocopy.

1. All engagements are on a part -time and temporary basis. These posts are 
not against any permanent vacancy. No claim for regular/permanent 
employment in BHEL shall be entertained.  
 
2. The Candidates should ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria and

Medical Practitioners as per BHEL Medical Attendance Rules.

they may produce relieving order from their organ ization in the event of 
selection.  
 
6. Candidates are advised to possess a valid e -mail ID, which is to be neatly 
and specifically provided in the Application Form. They are also advised to 
retain this e-mail ID active for at least one year as any important intimation 
to the candidates shall be provided by BHEL through email. They are 
further requested to check regularly their e -mail (including message in 
SPAM folder) for any communication from BHEL in this regard.  
 
7. BHEL reserves right to cancel/restrict/enl arge/reopen the engagement 
process and increase/decrease vacancies, if the need so arises, without 
issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereof. Posts indicated 
herein may be kept unfilled at the discretion of management.

out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can 
be instituted only at the respective cities / towns where the Units are 
located and the Courts / Tribunals / Forums (Jurisdic tion Courts) at the 
 
location where such unit is situated shall have sole and exclusive 
jurisdiction.

posting shall be entertained. Company reserves the right to change the 
place of posting as per administrative needs.  
 
10. If any candidate declines to join duty or gives resignation after joining duty 
within the first 2 months, the next suitable candidates shall be considered

12. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification .

की अिधि के दौरान जम्मू-कश्मीर राज्र् के ननिासी रहे हों। 
र्पृष्ठ 1 
  

 
 
 
काययकाल 
 
 र्ह ननर्ुश्तत र्पूरी तरह से दो साल की अिधि के ललए अस्थार्ी आिार र्पर है। बाद में इसे आगे बढाने 
का ननणयर् सिंतोषजनक कामकाज और मैनेजमेंट की मजी र्पर ननभयर करेगा। 
 
 इस ननर्ुश्तत को खत्म करने के ललए दोनों र्पक्षों की ओर से एक महीने का नोहटस र्पीररर्ड होगा। 
 
 
काम के घंटे 
र्ूननट के तर् कामकाजी हदनों के अनुसार, काम के घिंटे ज़्र्ादा से ज़्र्ादा आठ ( 8) घिंटे प्रनतहदन और 
सप्ताह में छह (6) हदन होंगे। 
अन्य लाभ 
छुट्टी: हर 20 हदन के काम र्पर एक हदन की छुट्टी। 
मेडडकल लाभ: स्िर्िं , र्पनत/र्पत्नी और आधित बच्चों के ललए 5 लाख रुर्पर्े तक की मेडडतलेम र्पॉललसी 
के प्रीलमर्म का रीइम्बसयमेंट।  
दुघयटना बीमा: बीएचईएल  र्पॉललसी के तहत ग्रुर्प र्पसयनल एतसीडेंट इिंश्र्ोरेंस की सुवििा होगी । 
आिास: एफटीए  को बैचलर आिास हदर्ा जाएगा। अगर किंर्पनी का आिास लमलता है, तो उर्पलब्िता के 
आिार र्पर लाइसेंस िीस ली जाएगी। 
 
म त्िपूर्य ननदेश 
 
• जॉइननिंग के समर् चररि और बैकग्राउिंड के बारे में स्ि-घोषणा (self-declaration) आिश्र्क है। 
• ननर्ुश्तत के समर् चुने गए वर्श्तत को मेडडकल फिटनेस सहटयफिकेट हदखाना होगा। 
उम्मीदिार का स्िास््र् अच्छा होना चाहहए। जॉइननिंग से र्पहले , चुने गए उम्मीदिारों को किंर्पनी के 
अधिकृत मेडडकल ऑफिसर र्ा सरकारी अधिकारी से तर् फॉमेट में मेडडकल जािंच करिानी होगी और 
ननर्ुश्तत किंर्पनी द्िारा तर् स्िास््र् मानकों को र्पूरा करने र्पर ही होगी। स्िास््र् मानकों में कोई छूट 
नहीिं दी जाएगी। किंर्पनी के मेडडकल जािंच के ननर्मों की सिंक्षक्षप्त जानकारी बीएचईएल की कररर्र िेबसाइट 
र्पर मौजूद ' बीएचईएल मेडडकल जािंच ननर्म' (BHEL's Medical Examination Rules) में देखी जा सकती 
है। 
इस ननयुक्तत से बीएचईएल में रेगुलर नौकरी का कोई अधिकार न ीं ममलेगा। 
चयन प्रककया  
चयन प्रककया के त त योग्य उम्मीदिारों का साक्षात्कार मलया जाएगा। य  साक्षात्का 'िॉक-इन' आिार 
पर 22.10.2026 को सुब  11.30 बजे से बीएचईएल कॉपय. आर&डी, विकासनगर, बालानगर,  ैदराबाद - 
500093 में  ोगा। साक्षात्कार में शालमल होने िाले उम्मीदिारों को कोई टीए/डीए नहीिं हदर्ा जाएगा। 
 
 
र्पृष्ठ 2 
  
 
 
आिेदन कैसे करें 
जो उम्मीदिार एिटीए - हहिंदी अनुिादक  ग्रेड III के र्पद के ललए आिेदन करना चाहते हैं, िे बीएचईएल 
की िेबसाइट http://careers.bhel.in से ररतत आिेदन  फॉमय डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं। उन्हें सही तरीके 
से भरा हुआ एप्लीकेशन फॉमय और नीचे हदए गए प्रमाणर्पि  की खुद से साक्षर्ािंफकत की हुई फोटोकॉर्पी  को 
साथ लेकर 23.10.2026 को होने िाले िॉक-इन साक्षात्कार में शालमल होना होगा। साक्षात्कार का र्पता है: 
एचआरएम विभाग, भू तल , प्रशासननक भिन , बीएचईएल कॉर्पय. आर&डी विकासनगर, हैदराबाद, 500093 
 
1.जन्म नतधथ का प्रमाण – एसएससी / इिंटरमीडडएट सहटयफिकेट 
2.मातसय ललस्ट के साथ ग्रेजुएशन सहटयफिकेट 
3.मातसय ललस्ट के साथ र्पोस्ट-ग्रेजुएशन सहटयफिकेट

अधिकारी के लेटर हेड र्पर हो। अनुभि सहटयफिकेट में र्े बातें साफ तौर र्पर ललखी होनी चाहहए: 
         a. हर उस सिंस्था में काम शुरू करने और छोडने की तारीख जहााँ उम्मीदिार ने काम फकर्ा है 
        b. िह क्षेि श्जसमें उम्मीदिार ने काम फकर्ा है। सिंबिंधित अनुभि का क्षेि दशायर्ा जाना चाहहए। 
5.कैटेगरी सहटयफिके ट (एससी /एसटी) अगर लागू हो। 
6.कैटेगरी सहटयफिकेट (ओबीसी नॉन-क्रीमी लेर्र) जो लसफय 01.08.2024 को र्ा उसके  बाद जारी फकर्ा 
गर्ा हो। 
7. ओबीसी नॉन-क्रीमी लेर्र िाले उम्मीदिारों के ललए तर् फॉमेट में स्ि-घोषणा र्पि (Self-undertaking), 
अगर लागू हो।

10.डोलमसाइल सहटयफिकेट (लसफय जम्मू एििं कश्मीर के उम्मीदिारों के ललए)।

ननकार्ों में काम करने िाले लोगों को उधचत माध्र्म (Proper Channel) से आिेदन करें

अन्य ननदेश 
 
➢ बीएचईएल के र्पास त्रबना कोई कारण बताए इस प्रफक्रर्ा को री-शेड्र्ूल/कैंसल/सस्र्पेंड/खत्म करने 
और फकसी भी कारण कभी भी ननर्म और शतों में बदलाि करने का अधिकार है। प्रबिंिन का 
फैसला अिंनतम होगा और फकसी भी अर्पील र्पर विचार नहीिं फकर्ा जाएगा। 
➢ इिंटरवर्ू/ननर्ुश्तत के ललए श्जन उम्मीदिारों का चर्न नहीिं हुआ के साथ कोई बातचीत/र्पिाचार

होगा।

« अभ्यर्थियों को यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि वे आवेदन करते समय सभी आवश्यक पात्रता मानदंडों एवं
शर्तों को पूरा करते हों तथा उनके द्वारा दी गई जानकारी पूर्णतः सही हो। यदि भर्ती प्रक्रिया के किसी भी चरण
में यह पाया जाता है कि अभ्यर्थी पात्रता मानदंडों को पूरा नहीं करता/करती है या गलत/झूठी जानकारी दी गई
है अथवा कोई महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य छिपाया गया है, तो उसकी अभ्यर्थिता रद्द की जा सकती है। नियुक्ति के बाद
भी ऐसी कमी पाए जाने पर सेवाएं समाप्त की जा सकती हैं तथा कानूनी कार्रवाई भी की जा सकती है।

कोई अपील स्वीकार नहीं की जाएगी। कंपनी को बिना कोई कारण बताए किसी भी आवेदन को अस्वीकार

*« इस विज्ञापन और/या इसके प्रत्युत्तर में दिए गए आवेदन से उत्पन्न किसी भी दावे या विवाद से संबंधित कोई

क्षेत्राधिकार प्राप्त होगा।
